_comment: Config for running ai-code-guardrails on its own repository. selfmod.protected_paths makes any PR touching the guard sources, the corpus, the workflows, or this file itself require the human-applied `guardrail-change` label - the same discipline the package enforces for its adopters.

test_integrity._comment: The default **/tests/** glob would scan tests/redteam/cases.py, whose case trees deliberately CONTAIN skip markers and weakened asserts as attack payloads - data, not tests. The real suite is tests/test_*.py; corpus changes are gated by selfmod.protected_paths instead.

deps._comment: Zero runtime dependencies is a floor of this package. The declaration file deliberately does not exist: an explicitly configured policy with no usable declaration file FAILS every new dependency, so adding one forces creating docs/dependencies.md (and the argument for it) in the same PR.
